 SCHD's Outperformance Won't Last
 Nov 03, 2026, 12:54 PM ET Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) 114 Comments 1 Like Daniel Jones Investing Group Leader Follow Summary
 Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF has outperformed expectations recently, delivering 31.57% YTD total return despite a rising interest rate environment.
 SCHD's strong performance is driven by outsized gains in energy, healthcare, and select technology holdings, notably Chevron, ConocoPhillips, and Amgen.
 I remain bearish on SCHD long-term, citing structural limitations, heavy reliance on large caps, and vulnerability to energy sector volatility.
 I reaffirm SCHD as a 'sell' candidate, expecting underperformance versus the broader market as current tailwinds subside and yield-seeking capital rotates.
